title: Enterprise Content Management (ECM) Business Analyst (66278)
description:
===============================================================
📌 POSITION & CLIENT OVERVIEW
===============================================================
• Position Title: Enterprise Content Management (ECM) Business Analyst (66278)
• Client / Agency: General Client
• Work Arrangement: Remote
• Interview Type: Webcam / In-Person
• Target Start Date: 9/21/2026
• Target End Date: 09/30/2027
• Submission Deadline: 9/11/2026

===============================================================
🎯 PROJECT SUMMARY & OBJECTIVE
===============================================================
Analyst: SME, Project Management, Bachelors Degree, Written And Verbal Communication Skills Position Location: Remote


Description;

The Department seeks a highly qualified World Languages Content Manager and Subject Matter Expert (SME) to provide leadership, content expertise, and project management support for statewide World Languages initiatives.

===============================================================
📋 KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES
===============================================================
• The contractor will collaborate with department staff, educators, district leaders, and advisory panelists to support the development and implementation of high-quality instructional resources, standards-aligned materials, and professional learning opportunities that advance World Languages education.
• The contractor will serve as the primary content expert for assigned World Languages projects and initiatives while ensuring alignment with state standards, instructional priorities, and department goals.
• Key Responsibilities

Materials Evaluation and Review

Develop, revise, and maintain World Languages instructional materials evaluation rubrics.
• Ensure evaluation tools align with state standards, instructional expectations, and department guidelines.
• Support the review and analysis of instructional materials and related resources.
• Provide recommendations regarding the quality, alignment, and usability of materials for educators and stakeholders.
• Advisory Panel Development and Management

Design and manage the application process for World Languages advisory panelists.
• Develop application materials, selection criteria, and review protocols.
• Review and analyze applications and provide recommendations for panel membership.
• Coordinate with department staff to ensure diverse and representative panel participation.
• Advisory Panel Training

Develop training materials and supporting resources for advisory panel members.
• Facilitate training sessions to prepare panelists for participation in standards, materials review, and other department initiatives.
• Provide ongoing guidance and content expertise throughout advisory panel activities.
• Support meeting planning, facilitation, and documentation as needed.
• Standards and Instructional Resource Support

Provide expertise related to World Languages standards and instructional shifts.
• Develop and revise instructional focus documents and supporting guidance materials.
• Assist with interpretation and implementation support related to World Languages standards.
• Collaborate with department staff to ensure consistency and alignment across resources and communications.
• Professional Learning and Presentations

Design and deliver presentations for educational leaders, district staff, and classroom educators.
• Develop professional learning materials that support implementation of instructional shifts and best practices in World Languages education.
• Facilitate virtual and in-person training sessions, workshops, and stakeholder meetings.
• Respond to stakeholder questions and provide technical assistance related to World Languages initiatives.
• Project Management and Collaboration

Manage assigned projects, timelines, deliverables, and communications.
• Collaborate with department staff and external partners to ensure successful completion of project goals.
• Prepare reports, summaries, presentations, and other project-related documentation.
• Maintain organized records and materials related to assigned initiatives.
• Additional Duties:

Perform other duties as assigned by the department in support of World Languages programs, instructional initiatives, and strategic priorities.

===============================================================
🛠️ REQUIRED TECHNICAL PROFICIENCIES
===============================================================
• Core Technical Proficiency in required functional & technical domain
• Experience with system architecture, workflow design, and access controls
• Strong problem-solving, documentation, and stakeholder collaboration capabilities

The max rate for this position is $95/hour.

The ITSM Change Process Manager is responsible for the governance, oversight, and continual improvement of the enterprise Change Management process, helping ensure changes to the IT environment are introduced in a controlled, coordinated, and secure manner with minimal disruption to business and IT services.

This position serves as the enterprise process owner for Change Management, establishing and maintaining change policies, standards, procedures, controls, and performance measures. The Change Process Manager oversees the end-to-end lifecycle of Standard, Normal, and Emergency Changes, including risk and impact assessment, authorization, scheduling, implementation oversight, post-implementation review, reporting, and closure.

Youll work closely with service owners, technical teams, Incident, Problem, Configuration, Release Management, and leadership to balance the need for change with operational stability. Youll also drive improvements through ServiceNow automation, analytics, governance, training, and adoption of ITIL Change Enablement best practices.

Key Responsibilities

• Functions as the enterprise authority governing Change Enablement across all NCDIT divisions and consolidated agencies - not only the process owner but the strategic leader for statewide change culture.
• Explicitly governs public-sector requirements, including SISM, audit controls, Expedited/Latent classifications, and high-visibility changes affecting state services.
• Adds enterprise escalation authority, allowing CAB/ECAB decisions to move upward to DSCIO/SCIO when required.
• Integrates statewide Forward Schedule of Change governance, with cross-agency conflict resolution and customer communication expectations.
• Expands role to lead ServiceNow modernization efforts, including automation restoration, risk scoring logic, CAB Workbench, dashboard design, and approval workflow improvements.
• Adds accountability for audit-ready documentation quality, ensuring Work Info records meet DITs documented requirements for Business Justification, Service Impact, Test/Install/Back-Out plans, and Install Results.
• Integrates more robust cross-domain coordination, specifically addressing enterprise operational dependencies, known gaps, and risk hotspots.
• Strengthens oversight of change-related incidents and operational stability initiatives.
• Adds executive-level communication responsibilities for high-impact or emergency changes.
• Elevates training and coaching into organizational change leadership, advancing statewide maturity rather than team-level competence.
• Establishes responsibility for strategic improvement initiatives, automation opportunities, and enterprise-level process redesign.

* Experience with Service Now or another enterprise ITSM/change management platform.

* Experience applying change governance, risk assessment, authorization and approval, scheduling, implementation, and compliance controls.
